snippet.description:
Are topper notes enough for your UPSC Sociology Optional preparation, or should you make your own short notes?

In this video, AIR 22 Geetika  explains why preparing your own short notes is important, especially for effective revision before the UPSC Mains examination.

With two Sociology Optional papers to revise in a limited time, going through bulky notebooks at the last moment can be difficult. Short notes help you revisit important keywords, thinkers, concepts and theoretical contributions without having to read everything in detail again.

Learn why your own short notes can make Sociology Optional revision more organised, focused and effective, and how they can help you recall important points during the examination.

Key takeaway: Don't just collect notes. Create a revision resource that works for you.

#SociologyOptional #UPSC2027 #UPSCMains #ShortNotes #SociologyPreparation #UPSCRevision #AIR22 #LevelUpIAS
